disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing substandard or dangerous service, repair, or installation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may reprimand, in writing, any certified contractor who provides substandard or dangerous service, repair, or installation, or who otherwise violates this chapter.
The board may remove, revoke, or suspend the certification of any certified contractor who provides substandard or dangerous service, repair, or installation, or who otherwise violates this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to renew certificate by December 31 of each year.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may impose late penalties on certified contractors who fail to renew certificates by December 31 of each year.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with minimum repair and service standards adopted by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Certified contractors who fail to comply with such minimum standards and criteria shall be punished as prescribed in Section 34-31-32(a).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in business as a certified contractor or performing the functions of a certified contractor in violation of this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any individual engaged in business as a certified contractor or performing the functions of a certified contractor in violation of this chapter shall be guilty of a Class A misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to cease work after hearing and notification from the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any failure to cease work, after a hearing and notification from the board, shall render an individual ineligible to apply for a certified contractor's license for a period not to exceed one year

bonding_required.quote: The board may require a performance bond not to exceed twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000) per year for all active certified contractors.
